slots.headline: Sidewalk sales bookend the coast this weekend
slots.note: Lewes merchants and the Rehoboth–Dewey resort area both run fall sidewalk sales Oct. 2–4, and Delaware Botanic Gardens in Dagsboro offers guided Welcome Walks at 10 a.m. on Oct. 2 and 3.

slots.headline: Boast the Coast opens Lewes Maritime Weekend
slots.note: Lewes Maritime Weekend starts today at 1812 Park and the City Dock on the canalfront, 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. It's free: Freedom Boat Club canal tours, live music from Jgar, kids' entertainment and free admission to the Cannonball House. A one-hour narrated history cruise with Cape Water Tours is the one paid extra.

slots.headline: Fifty years of Coast Day
slots.note: Coast Day turns 50 today. The University of Delaware opens its Hugh R. Sharp Campus in Lewes from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m., free, for hands-on marine science, live demonstrations, and lab and ship tours. Fifth graders can still enter the essay contest on Delaware's habitats and ecosystems through Oct. 9.
